mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) reflects accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods with FEDFUNDS < 0.5% are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 0.5% signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing risk appetite, causing negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods with FEDFUNDS > 0.5% are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When federal funds rate exceeds 0.5% and unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, it indicates tightening monetary policy and labor market stress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods with FEDFUNDS > 0.5% AND UNRATE > 4.5% are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%), increased discount rates and reduced risk appetite cause negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods with FEDFUNDS > 0.5% are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.5%) indicates a tight labor market supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods with UNRATE < 4.5% are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 5.0% signals labor market deterioration and reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods with UNRATE > 5.0% are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1000 and industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105, it indicates a weakening economy with reduced consumer and business activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns in periods with HOUST < 1000 AND INDPRO < 105 are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a strong demand cycle (HOUST > 1100 AND RSAFS > 450000), robust consumer and business spending drives positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns in periods with HOUST > 1100 AND RSAFS > 450000 are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
